C-bets most flops, BUT may check dry/paired boards. Turn: AIR → checks/folds (float profitable); REAL HANDS → continues aggressively (shoves with overpairs). Folds to turn raises even after double-barreling. **Facing donk-leads: calls one street then folds to continued pressure — CONFIRMED multiple times.** Fires big when opponent shows weakness — but if P2 checks after opponent shows weakness, P2 likely has air. **As 3-BET CALLER (OOP)**: More fit-or-fold — folds to c-bets when whiffing. **Player 3**: **Selectively aggressive, skilled — most dangerous opponent. PERSISTENT LOSER across many sessions — likely overadjusting or running bad.** Opens and 4-bets wider than premium (suited aces, medium pairs). 3-bets from blinds vs ALL position opens — blind 3-bet range is wider than typical. On wet boards in 3-bet pots, P3 checks strong hands to set up check-raises. **Exploit**: C-bet when P3 checks disconnected/dry boards. Don't value-bet thin on river. Call P3's 3-bets IP with strong suited hands. On wet boards, be prepared to call check-raises with overpairs.

## Core Strategy

1. **VPIP target: 20-25%.** Tight image = fold equity = primary profit. Proven over 13+ sessions (260+ hands). This session validated: folding 70% of hands + maximizing one premium = +$1873.
2. **SUITED is king**: Suited broadways and suited connectors are highest-EV aggression hands. Offsuit broadways only AJo+ from CO/BTN. K-x suited, A-x suited profitable steals.
3. **Station exploit (P2, P4, P5 w/pairs, P6, P7)**: Value bet wide, NEVER bluff postflop, isolate limps.
4. **P2 preflop**: Flat P2's opens with suited broadways/connectors IP. Reserve 3-bets for QQ+/AKs (5-bet) and AQs/JJ (call 4-bet). C-bet most boards when P2 calls 3-bet.
5. **P4**: ONLY float vs single raise. RESPECT 3-bets AND 4-bet calls. Value bet wide — P4 is #1 value target (when present). P4's 5-bet shoves include JJ — call with QQ+.
6. **P5**: Two-barrel bluff donk-bets. Call flop c-bets wider. Do NOT multi-barrel when P5 shows pair commitment.
7. **P6**: Isolate limps wide for value. FOLD to 4-bet shoves. Value bet wide postflop. Respect massive overbets. Do NOT semi-bluff raise P6 as limper. Bluff only PFA spots on ace-high boards.
8. **P3 (skilled)**: Call 3-bets IP with strong suited hands. Avoid thin river value. DO NOT float without 9+ clean outs. Expect wet-board check-raises.
9. **P7**: At ~$67, treat as shove/fold opponent. Call shoves liberally. If P7 rebuilds, value-bet relentlessly and respect cold-call traps.
10. **Threat hierarchy**: P3 (skilled) > P7 (aggressive/trappy) > P2 (LAG volume) > P5 (sticky pairs) > P6 (spewy). P4 if returns.
11. **SMALL/MEDIUM PAIRS (22-88)**: Set-mine cheaply only. Check-fold on miss.
12. **Win mechanism**: Profits from preflop/flop aggression with fold equity + value betting stations. Both engines essential. One big premium hand can define an entire session — patience is rewarded.
13. **Semi-bluff discipline**: Big draw semi-bluff raises only profitable against opponents who fold. Against stations (P2, P4, P6), prefer calling with draws and realizing equity.
